question: Which diverse classes of beings are included among those associated with this teaching?
premises: Several categories of beings are listed.
The list includes celestial, semi-divine, and demonic beings.
inference: Gandharvas, kinnaras, yakshas, asuras, and ascetics are all included.
uncertainties: garndhavāḥ appears to be a nonstandard spelling of gandharvāḥ
plain_english: Gandharvas, kinnaras, yakshas, asuras, and ascetics are included.
